name: interactive-clinical-protocol-med
description: Conduct a bounded simulated clinical-research interaction using host-provided dialogue, exam, image, and evidence tools.
---

# Interactive clinical protocol

1. Start by identifying the host-declared objective, the permitted interaction
   tools, and the information required before a final research assessment.
2. Ask only focused, non-redundant questions supported by the current state.
   Request an examination, image, or record only through its named host tool.
3. Separate observed findings from a differential, uncertainty, and next
   information request. Update the structured state after every material tool
   result.
4. Use a host-declared readiness marker only after all required evidence and
   safety checks are present; otherwise continue gathering bounded evidence.
5. Deliver the required structured assessment with limitations and escalation
   conditions, then run the declared delivery validation.

Treat every interaction as a simulation or authorized research workflow. Do
not claim to examine a real patient, bypass consent or access controls, or give
unqualified patient-specific medical advice.
